messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: page fired for service "model-catalog-config" (high). Trigger: model-catalog-defaults-change -> 502s and tokenization mismatch errors across multiple regions. Pager: mia
incident-bot: INCIDENT STARTED by Mia at 1998765432. Channel: #eng-oncall. Priority: P1. Runbook: model-catalog-rollback.md
Mia: acked. I'm on it, pulling logs + recent catalog changes.
Alejandro: I saw a batch of catalog promos ~2m ago, revision 202->203 default_variant changed to "fp16-quant" and tokenizer set to "byte-bpe-v2".
Jordan: that tokenizer isn't compatible with the model binary we ship for that variant. Clients get tokenization error: "Unknown token byte 0xA2" and downstream generation fails with 500.
Mia: can we confirm which customers hit this?
Raj: checking traces. looks like embedding endpoints for tenants: redwood-payments, insightly, and staging-org-3 are erroring. 5xx rate spiked from 0.2% -> 18% in last 3 minutes.
Sophie: I'm on customer comms. Holding message draft. Need ETA for mitigation.
Mia: immediate mitigation plan: 1) revert catalog revision to 202 (pin) 2) route traffic to fallback variant (fp16-legacy) 3) unpublish the faulty variant 4) start postmortem. Who can run the revert?
Alejandro: I can run the revert via `catalogctl promote --revision 202 --service model-catalog --force` and then `catalogctl set-weight --model model-abc --variant fp16-legacy --weight 100`. Will do in 30s.
Raj: FYI hitting config server show error: `catalog-server: failed to validate tokenizer=byte-bpe-v2 against model model-abc rev:203`. That validation should have prevented this, looks like the preflight hook didn't run for this promotion.
Mia: do the revert + weight change. I'll monitor logs and open a tracer.
Alejandro: running promote now...
Alejandro: ```
$ catalogctl promote --revision 202 --service model-catalog --force
Promoting revision 202 -> success (applied to region us-west-2, eu-west-1)
$ catalogctl set-weight --model model-abc --variant fp16-legacy --weight 100
Routing weights updated
```
Mia: seeing traffic shift. 5xx rate dropping to 3% in us-west-2.
Raj: starting a rolling restart of model workers for model-abc to ensure no stale KV caches referencing tokenizer 203. `k8s rollout restart deploy/model-abc -n serving`
Jordan: quick note: embeddings generated from partial tokenization before revert can still be wrong in caches. We should invalidate prefix cache for affected model keys. Command: `redis-cli --scan | grep model-abc | xargs redis-cli del` (we'll scope to keys matching tenant list).
Mia: Sophie, update customers: short outage, we reverted to previous variant, no data loss, we are monitoring. ETA for full recovery 10m.
Sophie: sending now: "We're investigating increased 5xx on embeddings; immediate hotfix applied, routing to a safe variant. We'll follow up with root cause and timeline for permanent fix." :white_check_mark:
Raj: 1) 5xx reduced to 0.6% after cache invalidation and roll restart. 2) no CPU/GPU OOM seen. Memory looks stable.
Mia: great. Escalation timeline: if any region >1% 5xx in next 15m escalate to eng-sre and oncall lead. For now, I'll page the model-oncall and schedule a quick blameless postmortem.
incident-bot: Acknowledgement recorded: Mia at 1998765433. Pager duty: acknowledged at 1998765435.
Alejandro: I've put a temporary guard in CI: block promotions that change tokenizer without matching model-compat list. Patch PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/catalog/pull/483 (will merge after tests).
Jordan: note for follow-up: our preflight validator missed the tokenizers matrix for model-abc. Might be a data drift between model manifests and the catalog.
Mia: handoff: I'm on for containment and initial RCA. Raj, can you take primary for follow-up and postmortem? I'll update incident doc and hand over in 10m.
Raj: taking post-incident ownership. I'll collect timelines, affected tenants, and next-actions.
Sophie: i'll schedule customer follow-ups and coordinate comms postmortem.
Mia: closing the live pager: 5xx below threshold across all regions, fallback stable. Leaving channel for Raj to continue writeup. Thank you everyone. :pray:
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED: status=mitigated, mitigations=[catalog-revert, route-fallback, cache-invalidate, worker-restart], owner=Raj, severity=P1 -> P2.
Mia: final note before handoff: add `catalog->preflight` integration test for tokenizer/model compatibility and add alert for preflight-skips.
Raj: adding to postmortem checklist. ETA for postmortem doc 48h.
Sophie: will prepare customer postmortem bundle.
Mia: handing off now. Leaving follow-up tasks in the incident ticket #INC-2026. Good job everyone. :tada:
